```{r}
library(dplyr)

# PET
pet <- base %>%
  filter(edad >= 15) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(fact_cal))

# Fuerza de trabajo
ft <- base %>%
  filter(edad >= 15, activ %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(fact_cal))

# Ocupados
ocupados <- base %>%
  filter(edad >= 15, activ == 1) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(fact_cal))

# Desocupados
desocupados <- base %>%
  filter(edad >= 15, activ == 2) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(fact_cal))

# Informales
informales <- base %>%
  filter(edad >= 15, activ == 1, ocup_form == 2) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(fact_cal))
```

```{r}
tgp <- ft$total / pet$total * 100
to  <- ocupados$total / pet$total * 100
td  <- desocupados$total / ft$total * 100
toi <- informales$total / ocupados$total * 100
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)

base <- base %>%
  mutate(
    edu1_limpia = ifelse(edu1 %in% c(88, 99), NA, edu1),
    
    anos_educ = case_when(
      edu2 == 0 ~ 0,                         # Nunca estudió
      edu2 %in% c(1, 2) ~ 0,                 # Sala cuna / kínder
      
      edu2 == 3 ~ edu1_limpia,               # Básica o primaria
      
      edu2 %in% c(4, 5, 6) ~ 8 + edu1_limpia, # Media común, TP, humanidades
      
      edu2 %in% c(7, 8, 9) ~ 12 + edu1_limpia, # CFT, IP, Universitario
      
      edu2 == 10 ~ 16,                       # Postítulo
      edu2 == 11 ~ 18,                       # Magíster
      edu2 == 12 ~ 20,                       # Doctorado
      edu2 == 14 ~ 12,                       # Normalista
      
      edu2 %in% c(88, 99, 902) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Tabla: distribución de escolaridad para todos y ocupados
tabla_educ_comparada <- base %>%
  filter(!is.na(anos_educ)) %>%
  mutate(
    grupo = ifelse(activ == 1, "Ocupados", "Todos")
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(
    base %>%
      filter(!is.na(anos_educ)) %>%
      mutate(grupo = "Todos")
  ) %>%
  group_by(grupo, anos_educ) %>%
  summarise(personas = sum(fact_cal, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(grupo) %>%
  mutate(porcentaje = personas / sum(personas) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r}
tabla_todos <- base %>%
  filter(!is.na(anos_educ)) %>%
  group_by(anos_educ) %>%
  summarise(personas = sum(fact_cal, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(grupo = "Todos")

tabla_ocupados <- base %>%
  filter(!is.na(anos_educ), activ == 1) %>%
  group_by(anos_educ) %>%
  summarise(personas = sum(fact_cal, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(grupo = "Ocupados")

tabla_educ_comparada <- bind_rows(tabla_todos, tabla_ocupados) %>%
  group_by(grupo) %>%
  mutate(porcentaje = personas / sum(personas) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(fixest)
library(modelsummary)

# 1. Base de regresión
reg_base <- base %>%
  filter(
    activ == 1,
    ocup_form %in% c(1, 2),
    ing_t_t > 0,
    habituales > 0,
    !is.na(anos_educ)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    informal = ifelse(ocup_form == 2, 1, 0),
    ingreso_hora = ing_t_t / (habituales * 4.33),
    ln_w = log(ingreso_hora),
    exp_pot = pmax(edad - anos_educ - 6, 0),
    sexo = factor(sexo),
    nivel_educ = factor(edu2),
    region = factor(region)
  )

# 2. Recorte 1% inferior y superior de ln(w)
p1  <- quantile(reg_base$ln_w, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
p99 <- quantile(reg_base$ln_w, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

reg_base_trim <- reg_base %>%
  filter(ln_w >= p1, ln_w <= p99)

# 3. Modelos progresivos
m1 <- feols(
  ln_w ~ informal,
  data = reg_base_trim,
  weights = ~fact_cal,
  vcov = "hetero"
)

m2 <- feols(
  ln_w ~ informal + sexo,
  data = reg_base_trim,
  weights = ~fact_cal,
  vcov = "hetero"
)

m3 <- feols(
  ln_w ~ informal + sexo + edad + exp_pot,
  data = reg_base_trim,
  weights = ~fact_cal,
  vcov = "hetero"
)

m4 <- feols(
  ln_w ~ informal + sexo + edad + exp_pot + anos_educ,
  data = reg_base_trim,
  weights = ~fact_cal,
  vcov = "hetero"
)

m5 <- feols(
  ln_w ~ informal + sexo + edad + exp_pot + anos_educ | nivel_educ,
  data = reg_base_trim,
  weights = ~fact_cal,
  vcov = "hetero"
)

m6 <- feols(
  ln_w ~ informal + sexo + edad + exp_pot + anos_educ | nivel_educ + region,
  data = reg_base_trim,
  weights = ~fact_cal,
  vcov = "hetero"
)

# 4. Cuadro de resultados
etable(m1, m2, m3, m4, m5, m6)
```


```{r}
modelsummary(
  list(
    "(1) No condicionada" = m1,
    "(2) + Sexo" = m2,
    "(3) + Edad/experiencia" = m3,
    "(4) + Escolaridad" = m4,
    "(5) + FE educación" = m5,
    "(6) + FE región" = m6
  ),
  statistic = "std.error",
  stars = TRUE,
  coef_map = c(
    "informal" = "Informal",
    "sexo2" = "Mujer",
    "edad" = "Edad",
    "exp_pot" = "Experiencia potencial",
    "anos_educ" = "Años de escolaridad"
  ),
  gof_map = c("nobs", "r.squared")
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(oaxaca)
set.seed(123)

reg_small <- reg_base_trim %>%
  sample_n(5000)

oaxaca_model <- oaxaca(
  ln_w ~ sexo + edad + exp_pot + anos_educ | informal,
  data = reg_small,
  R = 1
)

summary(oaxaca_model)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)

# Cuadro resumen Oaxaca-Blinder
tabla_oaxaca <- data.frame(
  Componente = c(
    "Brecha total",
    "Parte explicada",
    "Parte no explicada",
    "% explicado",
    "% no explicado"
  ),
  Valor = c(
    oaxaca_model$y$y.diff,
    oaxaca_model$twofold$overall[3, "coef(explained)"],
    oaxaca_model$twofold$overall[3, "coef(unexplained)"],
    oaxaca_model$twofold$overall[3, "coef(explained)"] / oaxaca_model$y$y.diff * 100,
    oaxaca_model$twofold$overall[3, "coef(unexplained)"] / oaxaca_model$y$y.diff * 100
  )
)

tabla_oaxaca <- tabla_oaxaca %>%
  mutate(Valor = round(Valor, 3))

tabla_oaxaca
```

```{r}
flextable(tabla_oaxaca) %>%
  autofit()
```
